reviewers.summary: The entry is mostly sound. I found a few minor problems: the collocation "the same thing" sits under the object sense, and the definition of "the last thing" is circular. The definitions of "sure thing", "no such thing" and "first things first" are weak. The grammar adaptation note overstates the determiner rule and repeats sense 3. "Among other things" has no coverage.
